description: One to three short paragraphs about the opening situation, without giving away the plot or the endings.

intro: Opening text on the start screen.
start.continue: Pick up where you left off
start.tip: Move on with the button, the space bar or the → arrow, and pick options by clicking or with keys 1–9. The story saves itself.
start.note: The ending does not depend on your last click.
start.nameLabel: What is your name? (you can leave it empty)
start.genderLabel: The form used when writing about you:
start.hintFound: Name recognised. You can change the form.
start.hintUnknown: I do not recognise that name. Pick the form we should use when writing about you.
start.hintNeed: Pick a form so we can begin.

paragraphs.t: You stand at a crossroads, {ime}. Two roads lie before you.
paragraphs.lead: Two roads, and you stand between them.

paragraphs.t: The road to the left leads to ending A.
paragraphs.lead: The road that led to the left.

paragraphs.t: The road to the right leads to ending B.
paragraphs.lead: The road that led to the right.
